source.name: Fenix-Premier Tech (team site): Fenix-Premier Tech unveils special edition jersey for Tour de France Femmes avec Zwift
source.quote: Developed together with cycling apparel partner Alè
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention. Alé lists Fenix Premier Tech under its road teams (alecycling.com/pages/ale-teams); its logo sits in the jersey's left chest stack and PR-S badge on the hem, and on the bib thighs.

summary: 2026 UCI Women's WorldTeam kit by Alé: a rust-orange jersey with 'FENIX INNOVATIVE MATERIALS' above 'PREMIER TECH' across the chest (Fenix, the Arpa Industriale brand, is title partner; Premier Tech is co-title partner from 2026 after the club's rebrand from Fenix-Deceuninck). The viewer's-right chest stack carries Zwift, Canyon and Škoda; the viewer's-left stack the Alé logo (kit maker), ABUS and the UCI Women's WorldTeam badge (a UCI label, not a sponsor). The collar carries 'FENIX' (left) and 'PREMIER TECH' (right); Premier Tech runs down the wearer's-right sleeve and Fenix down the other. The upper back repeats 'FENIX INNOVATIVE MATERIALS' above 'PREMIER TECH', with 'PREMIER TECH' and its shield on the side panel. The black bib shorts carry Premier Tech and Zwift down one thigh, 'wahoo' above the other leg's cuff, 'Alpecin' across the seat, and 'FENIX INNOVATIVE MATERIALS' down the back of one leg; Alé logos appear on the jersey and bibs (kit maker, listed as partner). Marked complete: Alé's official 2026 replica garment photos (front and back views of jersey and bib shorts) were checked and match this description. Note: for the Tour de France Femmes avec Zwift 2026 the team raced a special FENIX × Zwift edition jersey (team announcement of 2026-07-29), which is a separate special-edition kit.
